chapter.neroquests.space_race.title: The Space Race
quest.neroquests.groundwork.what_this_bo: This book keeps the record of your world. In view mode you browse chapters, read quests and claim what you have earned; players with editor access can switch to edit mode and author chapters and quests of their own for everyone on the server. Chapters from other Neroland mods appear here as you install them, and leave quietly when you do not. To start, hold a crafting table.
Every space programme starts with somebody splitting wood. Gather timber, set up a bench, and put a stone edge on something. The stars can wait one afternoon.
quest.neroquests.groundwork.first_shelte: A bed and a couple of crates. Unglamorous, but the first habitat module you will ever build — and the only one you get to test at ground level.
quest.neroquests.groundwork.coal_and_tor: Dig out fuel and turn it into light. Everything that comes later — furnaces, forges, engines — is this same trick at a larger scale.
quest.neroquests.groundwork.pest_control: The night shift objects to your survey work. Persuade it otherwise. A launch site has to be quiet before it can be loud.
quest.neroquests.groundwork.iron_age.des: Build a furnace and stock up on iron. It is the dullest metal you will ever hold and the one every machine in the ecosystem is quietly made of.
quest.neroquests.groundwork.ironclad.des: Nine ingots, one block. Learn to think in blocks rather than pieces — the whole industrial chapter is measured that way.
quest.neroquests.groundwork.redstone_awa: Red dust that carries a decision from one place to another. Primitive, but it is the same idea as the control bus on a rocket gantry.
quest.neroquests.groundwork.moving_parts: A piston pushes, a hopper feeds. Put a signal behind them and you have stopped doing the work yourself. Automation begins here.
quest.neroquests.groundwork.diamond_stan: Go deep, come back rich, and cut yourself a pick that will not quit halfway through a seam. You will need the reach.
quest.neroquests.groundwork.breaking_gro: Cool the lava, cut the obsidian, carry a flame in your pocket. The ground is behind you now — next comes the machinery that leaves it.
A blast furnace and a stockpile of iron. From here the question stops being 'can I make this' and starts being 'how many per minute'.
quest.neroquests.industrial.bulk_smeltin: Copper by the stack and hoppers to move it. Feed the furnaces instead of standing at them — that is the whole of industry in one sentence.
quest.neroquests.industrial.pressed_and_: Plates and dusts: the processed forms every tech mod trades in. If nothing on this server presses metal yet, those steps simply stand down and the compressed redstone will do.
quest.neroquests.industrial.machine_shop: A crafter, a pair of observers, a dropper. Give a workshop eyes and hands and it will keep working while you sleep.
quest.neroquests.industrial.alloy_ambiti: Nero Alloy is the ecosystem's working metal. Making it takes alloy dust from a Neroland mod that grinds meteor material, so this optional detour stays hidden until you have reached orbit — by then a world that can make it has shown itself.
quest.neroquests.industrial.power_up.des: Iron for the frame, gold for the contacts, a rod on the roof to catch the sky. Assemble the parts list of a generator before you assemble the generator.
quest.neroquests.industrial.age_of_indus: The anvil rings and the tier turns over. Completing this opens the Industrial Power milestone, and every Neroland mod on this server starts treating you as an engineer.
quest.neroquests.space_race.eyes_on_the_: Industrial Power is behind you. Grind a lens, look up, and pick a target. The Star Guide has been waiting for someone to ask.
quest.neroquests.space_race.launch_mater: Airframes are not made of good intentions. Stockpile structural metal — nerosteel if a mod on this server smelts it, iron if not.
quest.neroquests.space_race.reach_for_or: Ride something loud until the sky goes black. The first orbit on a server is worth telling the whole server about.
quest.neroquests.space_race.green_horizo: Greenxertz: breathable-adjacent, aggressively green, full of things worth digging up. Set boots on it. Appears once you have reached orbit; if no mod on this server provides the world, reaching orbit is enough.
quest.neroquests.space_race.first_colony: Somewhere off-world, something you built has a name and an address. A milestone the whole server should hear about.
quest.neroquests.space_race.deep_space.d: Past the easy orbits, out to the cold and the cinders. Cindara is the sort of place that measures how good your suit really is.
quest.neroquests.space_race.united_front: A world goal, not a personal one: the day anyone on this server holds both a colony and deep space, the frontier is settled for everybody. Completed once, celebrated by all.
quest.neroquests.market.open_for_busines: Every economy starts with one sale and one purchase. Make both and you are officially in business.
quest.neroquests.market.iron_trader.desc: Sell 64 iron ingots on the market. Industry runs on iron, and someone always needs more of it.
A hundred settled sales, a steady stream of purchases, and credits earned from more than trading alone.
